title: 1956 Bird Land All Stars tour
summary: The ten-week tour had Phil Woods, Kenny Dorham and Al Cohn in a small band, alongside Basie, Sarah Vaughan and Lester Young.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: Let’s see if there’s a date on here?
‘57. Hollywood, California. It’s got a little conversation in here with James Razzi, but the conversation is more recent, that he was talking to you I guess.
Yeah, I’ll sell this to you if you want.

You know that particular album, doing Al Cohn’s thing, is because in ‘56, the year before, we worked together with the Bird Land All Stars. We went out tour for ten weeks, what a show. I mean the group that I was involved with was Phil Woods, Kenny Dorham, Al Cohn and myself, and it was like a west coast, we had a west coast rhythm section. And it was a little band and we recorded that. But on that show they had the Basie band, Joe Williams, Al Hibbler, Sarah Vaughan, Lester Young, who did two or three numbers with the Basie band, Bud Powell, and it was called the Bird Land All Stars, in ‘56.
Yeah. It was a great show. And actually I took a lot from that show from working with Al Cohn. Great guy.
